title: Electronic structure engineering of phosphorene through transition metal functionalization for toxic gas detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22386-22399
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00934D, Paper
Open Access

Shah Nawaz Khan, Akbar Hussain, Shabeer Ahmad Mian, Joonkyung Jang
Cobalt doping enables reversible sensing, while adsorption causes near-irreversible binding for gas capture. SO2 and CO show strong responses, while CO2 is weak. Performance improves via light recovery, bandgap tuning, and stability.
